## 2. Core Services Offered & Engagement Models

### 01. Full-Stack Web Application Development
- End-to-end web applications engineered with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, NestJS/Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
- Modern responsive layouts, fluid animations, robust error handling, and production-grade security.

### 02. SaaS MVP Rapid Prototyping (Zero-to-One in 2–4 Weeks)
- Transforming startup and enterprise product concepts into production-grade Minimum Viable Products within weeks.
- Zero-to-one delivery: architecture planning, data modeling, authentication, payment processing (Stripe, SSLCommerz), and automated cloud deployments.

### 03. Full-Stack SaaS Platform Architecture
- Scalable multi-tenant architectures, role-based access control (RBAC), subscription billing, quota metering, usage analytics, and webhook fulfillment.
- AI-integrated platforms: LLM pipelines, Socratic AI agents, streaming chat, token tracking, and OpenAI API integrations.

### 04. Custom Enterprise ERP & Operations Systems
- Custom ERP systems for inventory control, automated invoicing, multi-store stock synchronization, POS integrations, and vendor CRM.
- High-integrity transactions, audit logging, and financial ledger reporting.

### 05. Custom & Headless CMS Platforms
- Atomic content management systems, recursive page builders, editorial approval workflows, role-based moderation, and clustered SEO architectures.

### 06. High-Performance Backend & API Microservices (NestJS, Go, Node.js)
- Modular microservices and RESTful / WebSocket APIs engineered for high concurrency, low latency, and comprehensive OpenAPI / Swagger specifications.

### 07. Database Design & Optimization (PostgreSQL, Neon, Prisma, Redis)
- Relational schema modeling, index optimization, query tuning, and sub-millisecond in-memory Redis caching layers.

### 08. AI Agent & LLM Pipeline Integration
- OpenAI and Anthropic API integrations, streaming chat completions, custom Socratic tutor agents, prompt engineering, and usage cost optimization.

### 09. Interactive Frontend Engineering & 3D Web Experiences
- High-end interactive user interfaces utilizing Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, 3D Canvas, and accessible Swiss design aesthetics.

### 10. Technical Consulting, Architecture Audits & Code Reviews
- System design evaluations, database migration reviews, performance profiling, and modernization of legacy codebases.

## 4. Flagship Projects & Case Studies

### 01. Study Buddy — AI Socratic Tutor & Learning Platform for K-12
- **Slug**: `/projects/study-buddy-ai-tutor-platform`
- **Stack**: NestJS • Next.js • TypeScript • PostgreSQL • Prisma • OpenAI • Stripe • Docker
- **Client**: Kodevio Limited
- **Role**: Backend & Admin Dashboard Developer
- **API Docs**: https://studybuddyapi.kodevio.com/docs
- **Highlights**:
  - Socratic AI tutor with streaming and JSON chat modes and per-user daily quotas.
  - Automatic minor detection with a 5-clause parental consent workflow by email.
  - Server-side quiz generation and grading with anti-cheat answer hiding.
  - Free vs. Pro tier gating with Stripe Checkout, webhooks, and sandbox fallback.
  - Admin runtime tuning of AI models, temperature, system prompts, token usage, and cost logs.

### 02. MUOUZIK — Universal Music & Video Streaming Marketplace
- **Slug**: `/projects/muouzik-music-platform`
- **Stack**: NestJS • Next.js • Socket.io • TypeScript • AWS S3 • ChapChapPay
- **Role**: Full Stack Developer (Backend & Admin Portal)
- **Live URL**: https://muouzik.com
- **Highlights**:
  - End-to-end music marketplace built for artists and listeners in Guinea & West Africa.
  - Atomic multi-track album upload (album, tracks, trailers in a single API call).
  - Mobile money checkout via ChapChapPay (Orange Money, MTN MoMo, PayCard) with webhook fulfillment.
  - Ownership-gated audio streaming via AWS S3 SigV4 presigned URLs.
  - Real-time notifications and live support chat over Socket.IO.

### 03. RoktoLagbe — Real-Time Emergency Blood Donation & Network Platform
- **Slug**: `/projects/roktolagbe`
- **Stack**: Next.js • TypeScript • Node.js • Express • Redis • Cloudinary
- **Role**: Full Stack Developer
- **Live URL**: https://roktolagbe-sigma.vercel.app
- **Code**: https://github.com/mahdimonir/roktolagbe
- **Highlights**:
  - Nationwide emergency blood donation logistics connecting donors, hospitals, and blood banks.
  - Real-time donor availability management and geolocation tracking.
  - Institutional dashboards with manager verification and audit logging.
  - Instant Redis-backed caching and emergency request broadcast.
